summary: On June 29, 2026, Pathfinder Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K to announce a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per common share declared by its Board of Directors. The dividend is payable August 7, 2026 to holders of record July 17, 2026. No special situation is present; this is a standard recurring dividend declaration with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other transformative event. The filing contains only items 8.01 (Other Events) and 9.01 (Exhibits). No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are involved. What to watch: none – this is a routine dividend announcement.
